one_liner: fiveD is listed as developing BreatheAssist, a real-time ventilation aid backed by EXIST. The November 2026 IHK founder award is a reason to reach out.

top_signals.signal: Named a winner or finalist in the 2025 BayStartUP business plan competition.
The BreatheAssist project originated at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg and received EXIST Research Transfer support.
Received the IHK-Gründerpreis Mittelfranken in November 2026.

team: Dr. Michael Stelzig is a technical co-founder with a PhD, an FAU radar research leadership role, and prior experience at Siemens and Mercedes-Benz. Marcel Hoffmann is co-founder and managing director.
why_early: Unknown whether a priced round has happened. EXIST support is reported, but the funding summary does not document an investment round.
devils_advocate_risks: The company description names BreatheAssist, but the market and risk notes describe radar simulation. The product fiveD is commercializing is unclear.
Clinical evidence for the reported ventilation benefits is unknown.
next_step: HTGF Digital Tech & AI team: Ask the founders which product fiveD is commercializing: BreatheAssist or radar simulation software.
